articles.title: Onslaught — Critics Say Adam Wingard's Latest is a Mixed Bag of Action and Horror
articles.excerpt: The film receives mixed reviews, with some praising its nostalgic elements while others criticize its execution.
articles.image_caption: 'Onslaught' directed by Adam Wingard, now in theaters.
articles.nri_angle: As an English-language film, it is easily accessible for diaspora audiences. However, its reliance on genre tropes may not resonate with everyone.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mirzapur: The Movie — Critics Say Pankaj Tripathi and Ali Fazal Deliver a Thrilling Return to the Underworld
articles.excerpt: Critics are largely positive about the film, praising its engaging narrative and performances despite some concerns over its length.
articles.nri_angle: The film is available with subtitles, making it accessible for non-Hindi speakers in the diaspora. Fans of the series will find it a satisfying continuation of the story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sony Sets November 6 Global Release for Ramayana With Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi
articles.excerpt: The first Indian film to receive the 'Filmed for IMAX' label will get a worldwide theatrical release from Sony Pictures, timed to coincide with Diwali festivities.
articles.image_caption: Ranbir Kapoor stars as Lord Ram in Ramayana: Part One, set for a worldwide release on November 6, 2026 through Sony Pictures.
articles.nri_angle: Sony's global distribution marks the first time a Hollywood studio has given a mainstream worldwide theatrical release to an Indian film, with diaspora audiences expected to drive significant turnout alongside crossover appeal.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Toxic English Version Hits Indian Screens Today With Tighter 18-Minute Shorter Cut
articles.excerpt: The English version of Yash's pan-India gangster drama arrives in Indian cinemas on September 4 with a leaner runtime, even as the film's box office trajectory remains a talking point after a sharp post-opening decline.
articles.image_caption: Yash stars in Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, whose English version releases in Indian cinemas on September 4 with an 18-minute shorter cut.
articles.nri_angle: Lionsgate acquired international English distribution rights to target non-diaspora audiences in western theatrical chains, while Phars Film handles the five Indian-language versions overseas.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mirzapur: The Movie Opens Today With 90,000 Tickets Sold, Eyes Rs 30 Crore Debut
articles.excerpt: India's first OTT-to-theatrical franchise film has sold 90,000 advance tickets in top cinema chains, with industry insiders projecting a Rs 100 crore opening weekend.
articles.image_caption: Pankaj Tripathi, who returns as Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur: The Movie, released on September 4, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The Mirzapur franchise has a massive following among Indian diaspora audiences who streamed the original series on Amazon Prime Video, making it a cultural touchstone for NRIs worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Preity Zinta Worked 18-Hour Days on Vibe to Get Back to Her Kids in the US
articles.excerpt: The actor addressed Bollywood's work-hours debate at the trailer launch of her upcoming spy comedy, saying her grueling schedule was a personal choice driven by motherhood.
articles.image_caption: Preity Zinta, the Bollywood actress, spoke about her grueling schedule on the set of Vibe and the pull of returning to her children in the United States.
articles.nri_angle: Zinta's perspective as an NRI mother balancing Hollywood-adjacent life in LA with Bollywood commitments resonates with diaspora families navigating dual-country careers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yash's 'Toxic' Closes Week One at Rs 314 Crore Worldwide Amid Profitability Concerns
articles.excerpt: Despite crossing Rs 300 crore worldwide in seven days, steep daily drops and an estimated Rs 300-400 crore budget have trade analysts questioning whether the Kannada blockbuster can turn profitable.
articles.image_caption: Kannada star Yash at the Toxic trailer launch event. His film Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown Ups crossed Rs 314 crore worldwide in its opening week.
articles.nri_angle: Yash commands a significant following among the Indian diaspora, and Toxic'\''s worldwide gross includes Rs 40.75 crore from overseas markets where NRI audiences have contributed to the film'\''s international footprint.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dulquer Salmaan's 'I'm Game' Arrives September 3 in Five Languages
articles.excerpt: The big-budget fantasy action thriller marks Dulquer's Malayalam homecoming, with a pan-India release across five languages and a record-breaking music deal.
articles.image_caption: Actor Dulquer Salmaan at a promotional event. His multilingual fantasy action thriller I'm Game releases worldwide on September 3.
articles.nri_angle: Dulquer Salmaan's massive NRI fanbase, particularly among Malayalam-speaking diaspora, makes the worldwide release of I'm Game a significant entertainment event, with the film screening in multiple languages across global markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: JioHotstar Goes Global With Launch in UK, Canada and Singapore
articles.excerpt: India's largest streaming platform launches internationally with 160,000 hours of content but without the live cricket that drives its massive domestic audience.
articles.image_caption: The JioHotstar streaming platform logo. JioHotstar launched in the UK, Canada and Singapore, marking its first expansion outside India.
articles.nri_angle: JioHotstar's international launch directly targets the Indian diaspora in the UK, Canada and Singapore, giving NRI audiences access to the same entertainment platform popular in India — though without the cricket that many diaspora fans follow most closely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adnan Sami Blasts Bollywood's Remix Addiction: 'Corporates Are Scared to Experiment'
articles.excerpt: The singer-composer says music labels have flipped the original-to-remix ratio from 80:20 to 20:80, starving a generation of its own songs.
articles.nri_angle: Bollywood music serves as a cultural anchor for diaspora Indians, and the remix trend threatens to dilute the generational connection to original Hindi film songs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Lust Stories 3 Premieres September 18 on Netflix With Motwane, Kiran Rao and Vishal Bhardwaj
articles.excerpt: The International Emmy-nominated anthology returns for an unprecedented third season, featuring Radhika Apte, Ali Fazal, Aditi Rao Hydari and a fresh ensemble across four short films.
articles.nri_angle: The Lust Stories franchise on Netflix offers global Indian audiences a window into evolving conversations around intimacy and desire in contemporary India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses Rs 380 Crore in India, Becomes Highest-Grossing Film of 2026
articles.excerpt: The Marvel blockbuster surpassed Rs 300 crore in just six days, becoming only the third Hollywood film to achieve the feat in India.
articles.nri_angle: The film's massive Indian performance underscores Marvel's deep penetration into Indian entertainment culture.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Na Hong-jin's Cannes Sci-Fi Thriller HOPE Set for India Release on September 25 in Five Languages
articles.excerpt: The Korean monster epic starring Hwang Jung-min, Hoyeon, Michael Fassbender, and Alicia Vikander will release across India in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Korean.
articles.image_caption: Director Na Hong-jin, whose sci-fi thriller HOPE premieres in India on September 25 in five languages after winning acclaim at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival.
articles.nri_angle: Five-language India release reflects growing Indian audience appetite for Korean cinema, driven by the K-drama streaming boom.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yash's 'Toxic' Crosses Rs 200 Crore in India Net Collections by Day 5
articles.excerpt: The gangster actioner directed by Geetu Mohandas has surpassed Rs 255 crore worldwide and continues its strong first-weekend run.
articles.image_caption: Actor Yash at the Toxic trailer launch event. His latest film Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups has crossed Rs 200 crore in India net collections by its fifth day of release.
articles.nri_angle: Yash's 'Toxic' extends Kannada cinema's growing pan-India and global footprint, building on the KGF franchise's international success.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kartik Aaryan's Captain India Begins London Shoot on September 1
articles.excerpt: The Chak De! India director Shimit Amin helms the action drama inspired by India's wartime evacuation mission, with an August 2027 theatrical release locked in.
articles.image_caption: Actor Kartik Aaryan. His upcoming film Captain India begins its London shooting schedule on September 1.
articles.nri_angle: A Bollywood film rooted in India's evacuation missions abroad, with a London shoot connecting to diaspora audiences in the UK.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kuku Kohli, Director Who Launched Ajay Devgn in Phool Aur Kaante, Dies at 77
articles.excerpt: The veteran Bollywood filmmaker, whose 1991 debut gave Hindi cinema one of its most iconic opening sequences, died of cardiac arrest at Mumbai's Kokilaben Hospital.
articles.image_caption: Bollywood director Kuku Kohli at an IMPPA event in 2023. Known for launching Ajay Devgn in Phool Aur Kaante, Kohli died at the age of 77.
articles.nri_angle: Kohli's films, particularly Phool Aur Kaante, are cultural touchstones for the Indian diaspora who grew up on 1990s Bollywood — the motorcycle-split scene is recognized across generations of NRIs worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Taapsee Pannu Says Bollywood Still Won't Invest in Women-Led Action Films
articles.excerpt: Ahead of her Netflix action-drama Gandhari, the actress calls out Bollywood's persistent budget gap between male-led and female-led films, saying expensive technology needed for high-end action remains out of reach for women-fronted projects.
articles.nri_angle: Taapsee Pannu's critique of Bollywood's investment gap resonates with diaspora audiences who follow Hindi cinema and increasingly expect gender parity in storytelling and production values.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hrehaan Roshan, Hrithik's Son, Makes Music Debut With Indie Single From Berklee
articles.excerpt: The 20-year-old Berklee scholar releases 'This Heavenly Place,' an acoustic English-language track that marks the first independent music career from the Roshan family
articles.image_caption: Hrithik Roshan at an event. His son Hrehaan Roshan has released his debut indie single from Berklee College of Music.
articles.nri_angle: Hrithik Roshan's son Hrehaan, studying on a Berklee scholarship in the US, debuts as indie musician — first singer-songwriter from the iconic Roshan film family
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
